description:
The machinery over ADR-003 §3 (pseudonymous trails, born in US-004/US-005): erasable PII vault, erasure request flow, data-export (access request) flow, retention policies, automated no-PII-in-trails verification.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Erasure request completes while journal & lifecycle trails stay intact and verifiable
- Data-export produces the complete personal data set for a customer
- Automated check proves no raw PII in any append-only store; runs in the local gate

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map). Origin: backlog grilling 2026-07-12.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level; decompose when prioritized (Gate 1). Resolves the GDPR-vs-inalterability tension: design (pseudonymous IDs) lands in M1; machinery lands here.
